frozen_ppo.source_manifest_status_note: The atomic validator passed. 'unverified' is the checkpoint's pre-readiness evaluation label, not an integrity failure; the full readiness evaluation is recorded separately in this report.

metric_clarification.first_gate_crossing: Crossing gate 1. It does not assert that the gate-1 to gate-2 switch, reacquisition, alignment and range-decrease sequence also succeeded.
metric_clarification.first_transition: Full gate-1 to gate-2 transition at sequence position 1: gate 1 crossed, target switched, gate 2 aligned, and range decreased.

official_horseshoe_bay.label: Horseshoe Bay
official_horseshoe_bay.failure_classification_note: Every PPO run crossed at least gate 1 and ended when the referee recorded one missed-gate DNF at the next attempted gate. The observable terminal mechanism is therefore crossing/missed gate; the referee evidence does not support relabelling it as acquisition, target-switch or reacquisition failure.
